utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli, got my tools ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that's good. I'll be there too, just... not sure how much help I'll be.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Don't worry, just having an extra pair of hands helps. We'll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did you check if we have enough supplies for everyone who signed up? I don't want anyone to go without.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we've got a full list? I don't want to promise something we can't deliver.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's cross-reference with the sign-up sheet again, just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Oren, did you say something about a repair drive? I think I caught the tail end of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes! I was just thinking we should organize a little fix-it day for the block. Got a broken chair and a wobbly fence that could use some attention.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A fix-it day? That sounds like a good idea. I've got a squeaky gate that's been driving me nuts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, did you hear we're organizing a repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old blender to get it fixed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A repair drive? That sounds great! Where and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's at the community center on Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. I already told Marlon about it—he's bringing his broken toaster!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Dane! I've got my toolbox ready, we can start with the Smiths' fence if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good to me, Gus. Lead the way to the Smiths'—I've got some extra nails in my pocket just in case.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, I hope you've got a solid schedule for this repair drive. I like to know what's happening and when.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely! I've got it all mapped out — we're starting at 9 AM sharp at the community center, and I'll be spreading the word door-to-door tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good — I appreciate a plan with some precision. I'll be there at 9, and I'll bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs to be repaired?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure yet—mind if I take a quick look and see what's going on?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, go ahead. But let me know if you need any tools or help, I'd rather fix it right than patch it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal! I heard you're helping organize the neighborhood repair drive—what a great idea. I'd love to get my tools involved if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Jules, I'm so glad you're in! I've got a map of everyone's tool collections on my kitchen table—do you have a power drill or a socket set I can note down?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I've got both, actually! A power drill and a full socket set—happy to lend them out for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa, are you still planning to help me gather supplies for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara! I've already started a list of what we'll need from the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Rosa! Thanks for taking the lead on the list. How about we meet tomorrow to go over it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Bo, I've been meaning to ask—how are we doing on spare parts for the repair drive? I can pitch in with some tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think we're good for now—just gotta grab a few more hoses and we're set. Tools wouldn't hurt, though!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I've got a full set of wrenches and pliers. I'll bring them by later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I heard they're fixing up old appliances and electronics for free!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that sounds nice. I've got an old blender that's been sitting in my kitchen for months—maybe they can take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's perfect! I think they're taking small appliances like blenders, so you should definitely bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think I saw the repair drive in the shed last week, but I’ll double-check before we start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Hana! Let me know when you confirm, and we can plan the next steps around the school pick-up times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head to the shed now and check—should only take a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sure, just leave the tools in the shed when you're done.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Bo. By the way, I heard the repair drive is next Saturday—did you sign up yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer, but I've been so swamped I haven't had a chance to look at it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, I heard we're planning a repair drive this weekend—I'm definitely bringing my old toaster to fix up!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Vik! The more the merrier—I think Sarah's bringing her sewing machine too, so we'll have a real workshop vibe going.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Sarah's bringing her sewing machine? I'll make sure to let Mike know—he was asking about what tools people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Oh, the repair drive. Right, yeah, I think I saw something about that... maybe?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, huh? I'll try to remember that... but you know me, I might show up on Sunday instead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, you know, the neighborhood's doing a tool swap and repair day this Saturday. I've got a bunch of wrenches and saws folks can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds interesting. What time is it starting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa! I'd like to know where and when the repair drive will be held so I can mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure! It'll be this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center down on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have a plan for who brings what to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'll spread the word around the block! What do you think we need most—tools, snacks, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Tools, definitely tools. I can bring a socket set, but we should coordinate so we don't end up with five hammers and no wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did the repair drive actually come through? I need you to confirm because I've heard promises before.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the latest update from the team before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but I've heard that before too. You're sure you're not just stalling?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Dane, I hope you've got a solid schedule for this repair drive. I like to know what's happening and when.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, don't worry, I'll have the plan ready by tomorrow. Just need to double-check a few things first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear. I'll pencil it in for tomorrow evening then, just shoot me a copy when you've got it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, I heard you were organizing something about repairs—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I'm putting together a drive for spare parts and tools. The community center's repair bench has been running low on essentials.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds handy! I've got an old toolbox in my garage that's just collecting dust—want me to check what's in it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I've got a wobbly chair and a toaster that's been acting up—figured I'd bring them both. How about you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I, uh, think I might have something in my shed, but I can't recall what now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, have you heard anything about the repair drive for the school? I was thinking we could help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard they need tools and extra hands. Got a few hammers and saws I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Leo! I'll start a list of what everyone's bringing so we don't end up with ten hammers and no screwdrivers.
